#!/bin/bash
set -e
source /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/.venv/bin/activate
echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Running profiling case: toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc (2 MPI ranks)"
echo "Description: Periodic-slab ToyDrift setup, solving the per-step guiding-center Poisson problem with either feectools' native preconditioned CG (--solver pcg) or PETScSolver (KSP=cg, PC=gamg, --solver petsc)."
echo "Physics problem: Electrostatic E x B drift of a single ion species in a periodic slab."
echo "Struphy model used: ToyDrift"
echo "Case directory: /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T150052Z-1b936ad8/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc"
echo "----------------------------------------"
mkdir -p "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T150052Z-1b936ad8/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc/sim_04"
cp "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/profiling/examples/ToyDrift/periodic_slab/params_periodic_slab.py" "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T150052Z-1b936ad8/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc/parameters.py"

echo "Running toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc with 2 MPI ranks"
cd "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T150052Z-1b936ad8/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc"
mpirun -n 2 /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/.venv/bin/python /Users/max/git_repos/struphy/profiling/examples/ToyDrift/periodic_slab/params_periodic_slab.py --id 4 --solver petsc > "/Users/max/git_repos/struphy/_profiling_jobs/20260809T150052Z-1b936ad8/toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc/sim_04/struphy.out" 2>&1

echo "----------------------------------------"
echo "Completed profiling case: toydrift_periodic_slab_petsc (2 MPI ranks)"
echo "----------------------------------------"
